title: Wound of the Elbow-Joint Treated According to the Antiseptic System
lineage: Retained the original complete BMJ page 457 as a PNG scan directly served by the PMC article page; it contains Marshall’s complete one-page article. The page image was visually inspected. The PMC PDF download returned an interstitial and is not retained; the local copy is the page image, not a PDF. Details are historical, not medical advice.

passages.note: p. 457: Preston case dated 12 August 1869; author expressly adopted Lister’s antiseptic principles and describes his own carbolic regimen.
